## Type Aliases

### Accepted

```ts
type Accepted = Readonly<{
  status: "accepted";
  commandId: string;
}>;
```

Semantic acknowledgement returned after one durable acceptance commit.

---

### TooLate

```ts
type TooLate = Readonly<{
  status: "too_late";
  commandId: string;
}>;
```

Cancelling found nothing left to cancel: the command is unknown to this Session,
has already started (for an `onlyIfPending` cancel) or has already settled. It
is an ordinary outcome, never an error.

---

### UnknownRequest

```ts
type UnknownRequest = Readonly<{
  status: "unknown";
}>;
```

No command has been admitted under this request key in the addressed Session.

---

### CancelResult

```ts
type CancelResult = Accepted | TooLate | UnknownRequest;
```

Outcome of one cancel command or request-based recall.

---

### WithdrawResult

```ts
type WithdrawResult = Accepted | UnknownRequest;
```

Atomic admission resolution: accepted work is kept; an unknown key is fenced
forever.

---

### ForkedSession

```ts
type ForkedSession = Readonly<{
  sessionId: string;
}>;
```

Result returned after a fork commits a new cold-readable Session.

### SessionCompactionMarker

```ts
type SessionCompactionMarker = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  sequence: number;
  at: number;
  tokensBefore: number;
  tokensAfter: number | null;
  trigger: SessionCompactionTrigger | null;
}>;
```

Minimal full-history compaction boundary marker. `sequence` is the Woodstock
order of the row this marker precedes (ties sort the marker first); `at` is when
the compaction ran. The agent's model context is unaffected by this marker; it
exists only for the client timeline.

---

### SessionCompactionTrigger

```ts
type SessionCompactionTrigger = "manual" | "threshold" | "overflow";
```

What started a compaction: the user, the context threshold, or an overflow.

---

### SessionCompactionNotice

```ts
type SessionCompactionNotice = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  sequence: number;
  at: number;
  trigger: SessionCompactionTrigger;
  result: "nothing_to_compact" | "failed" | "stale" | "insufficient";
  diagnostic: string | null;
}>;
```

A compaction that changed nothing: a manual request with nothing to summarize
yet, a compaction that failed, or a finished background summary dropped
unplaced: stale because the context had moved past its head, or insufficient
because placing it would have left the context over the limit. Automatic
failures are never silent; each one is a notice at its own place in the
timeline.

---

### SessionContext

```ts
type SessionContext = Readonly<{
  tokens: number;
  window: number | null;
}>;
```

The Session's context use as compaction measures it, against the window of the
model a run would select now; the window is null when that model reports none.

### SessionInboxState

```ts
type SessionInboxState = "needs_you" | "running" | "errored" | "done";
```

Owner-decided inbox state, from Watchdog's queue head and latest outcome.
`running` covers queued, thinking, streaming, retrying and cancelling; `errored`
covers failed, interrupted and `outcome_unknown`; `done` covers completed,
cancelled and never run. Any open extension attention produces `needs_you`,
taking priority over live and settled work.

---

```ts
type SessionSummary = Readonly<{
  createdAt: number;
  lastActivityAt: number;
  settledAt?: number;
  title: string;
  state: SessionInboxState;
}>;
```

Read-only saved conversation projection; opening does not update recency.
